product_metadata.title: DampRid - Lavender Vanilla Moisture Absorber - 42 oz. Refill Bag – Attracts & Traps Moisture for Fresher, Cleaner Air
features: DampRid Refill Bag is a convenient, cost-effective way to replenish 10.5 oz. Refillable Moisture Absorber cups
DampRid eliminates odors by absorbing excess moisture out of the air that creates unpleasant, musty smells
Great for bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchens, and any space where excess moisture is an issue
The 42 oz. bag supplies four 10.5-ounce refills, each lasting up to 60 days, depending on temperature and humidity
To use, simply pour crystals into the top tray of the container. When the moisture absorbing crystals have dissolved, pour remaining liquid into the toilet and refill with fresh crystals
Made to go with the DampRid 10.5-Ounce Refillable Moisture Absorber (sold separately)
Use anywhere that excess moisture and stagnant air area a problem
description: The DampRid Refill Bag is your moisture absorber and odor eliminator solution for cleaner, fresher air. Eliminate musty odors and freshen the air by attracting and trapping excess moisture to maintain an optimal humidity level. DampRid works in bathrooms, closets, laundry rooms, or any space where excess moisture is an issue. Create long-lasting freshness as a bathroom odor eliminator or place in laundry room, kitchen, home office, stored boat or RV. When your Moisture Absorber container has done its work and the crystals have dissolved, pour the remaining liquid into the toilet and refill with fresh crystals for continuous protection against excess moisture and musty odors. Available in Fragrance Free, Fresh Scent, Lavender Vanilla, and Pure Linen. Keep out of reach of children. Read and follow all label directions.
